test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement(s) is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All pumpkin is mutton.

All mutton are fishes.

Conclusions:

(I) Some fishes are mutton.

(II) All pumpkins are fishes.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/756c6339ebe0251894598927f805d68a653510ce30697c5b589b4712531b9dc0.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some fishes are mutton → Follow (As all pumpkin is mutton and all mutton are fishes. As whole mutton comes in fishes, therefore it is true)

(II) All pumpkins are fishes → Follow (As all pumpkin is mutton and all mutton are fishes. As whole pumpkin comes in mutton which whole comes in fishes, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
